a.lede: Late-night hosts discussed disgraced Nvidia CEO’s quick return to his role after pressure from shareholder Trump Late-night hosts reacted to the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia under political pressure from Donald Trump . Continue reading...
a.title: Jimmy Kimmel on Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia: ‘What a profoundly stupid time to be alive’

b.lede: Denny's, the diner where Jensen Huang came up with the idea for Nvidia, has posted a 200-word statement to X in which it expressed its delight at his return to Nvidia after he initially resigned and admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
b.title: Denny’s touts renewed support for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following reinstatement
